observations: Photo 0 shows a black, cylindrical, perforated speaker with the word 'SONOS' vertically printed in white on the front.
The speaker has a matte finish and appears to be a portable Bluetooth speaker.
There is a watermark 'POSTED ON ESOJE & CO. ENTERPRISES' across the center of the image.
No visible damage, cracks, or wear is apparent in the photo.
No power cord, charging port, or buttons are visible in the photo.

claims.claim: Can work as a normal portable bluetooth speaker
claims.evidence: No power source, charging port, or Bluetooth functionality is visible. The photo does not show the speaker powered on or connected to a device.
The speaker is shown without any power source or charging cable. There is no visual proof of standalone operation.

claims.claim: All keys and buttons working, adapter included. Bought from the UK, no dead key, no crackle.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The speaker may not be a genuine Sonos Roam or may be a counterfeit.
risks.proof: A clear photo of the model label or serial number on the speaker, preferably from the back or bottom.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as a generic Sonos speaker, not as a Roam, which would be worth less.

risks.risk: The speaker may not be functional (e.g., no power, no Bluetooth, no charging port).
risks.proof: A video or photo showing the speaker powered on, connected to a device via Bluetooth, and charging.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as not working, since functionality cannot be confirmed remotely.

risks.risk: The speaker may be damaged or have internal issues not visible in the photo.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the charging port, speaker grilles, and any buttons or ports.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as potentially damaged, which reduces value.

proof_requests: Photo of the model label or serial number on the speaker.
Video or photo showing the speaker powered on and connected to a device via Bluetooth.
Photo of the charging port and any buttons or ports.
Photo of the back or bottom of the speaker to check for model or serial number.
response.reason: The item is known from the photos. What they cannot prove is priced at its worst case until the proof asked for below arrives.
